name: Moli | Headless Browser for AI Agents (CDP, WebDriver, Playwright)
description: Rust headless browser for AI agents: CDP, WebDriver, Playwright, ~30 MB
card_desc: Moli: an open-source headless browser built for AI agents. Connect Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or browser-use over CDP or WebDriver, behind a token gate, from a container that idles at a few dozen MB.
